item.title: Linux Basic Commands Experiment
item.description:
##Objective To master the basic file management commands in the Linux terminal.

##Practice Process In this experiment, I used the VirtualBox Ubuntu environment.

  • Created a new directory using mkdir linux_lab.
  • Listed files using ls -l.
  • Changed permissions for a script using chmod +x script.sh.

This is a solid foundation for further system administration.
